title: Tame Hecke Eigensheaves with Several Marked Points
summary: For SL n in characteristic p > n , we construct nonzero locally constructible perverse Hecke eigensheaves with Borel level at two or more marked points on a smooth projective curve of genus at least two over an algebraic closure of a finite field. The parameter is a Zariski-dense geometric ℓ -adic PGL n -local system with unipotent tame monodromy; its nilpotent logarithms may have any Jordan type, including zero. The eigensheaves have parabolic nilpotent singular support, and their eigenisomorphisms retain the full tensor and fusion structure.
family_title: Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan

review.reason: Constructs Hecke eigensheaves with Borel level at several marked points on curves.
